Traditional voice AI turns speech into text, generates a response, then reads it aloud. That can slow things down and miss important clues like frustration or hesitation. Rime just launched Prism, a new AI model built to make phone conversations smarter and more natural. Here's what makes it interesting: → Understands how callers sound, not just the words they use. → Lets businesses check responses before they're spoken. → Can be trained on a company's real customer calls. Rime reports Prism got customer approval before placing 94% of orders, compared to 57% with an OpenAI model. The next generation of voice AI won't just sound more human. It'll understand humans better. Check out Prism and try it for free.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: The Fed's hold sapped a brief rally, pushing Bitcoin back under $80K as ETH ETFs bled. Yet institutions kept building: Coinbase embraced RLUSD and Google entered bank custody. 🏦 Fed Holds Rates, Bitcoin Slips Back Below $80K The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged at its October meeting, as markets expected. Bitcoin briefly bounced above $81,000 after the decision, but the move faded into renewed selling, with BTC trading near $79,700 early Thursday while Ethereum hovered around $2,300 and XRP lost about 3% to $1.29. Read full story 📉 Ethereum ETFs Log Third Straight Day of Outflows U.S. spot Ether ETFs shed roughly $170 million across October 26–28, according to SoSoValue data, adding pressure on ETH as it tested the $2,300 support zone. Technical indicators remain bearish, though the Money Flow Index has climbed back from oversold levels. More details 💵 Coinbase Lists Ripple's RLUSD Across Retail and Prime Coinbase rolled out support for Ripple's dollar-backed RLUSD stablecoin on its retail app, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Prime, with 1:1 conversion from USD and deposits on XRP Ledger, Ethereum and Base. Collateral support on Coinbase's global exchange is set to follow, capping a week that also brought a Robinhood partnership and a Moody's A2 rating for the $2.4B token. Read more 🔐 Google Unveils MPC Crypto Custody Platform for Banks At its first digital assets symposium in New York, Google Cloud introduced Google Multi-Party Compute, a custody service that splits private-key shares across separate environments so no single machine holds a full key. Several major financial institutions are testing it in private preview, with commercial availability targeted for early 2027 — putting Google in direct competition with Fireblocks and BitGo. See details 💰 Strategy Shareholders Approve Daily Preferred Dividends Strategy investors backed an amendment letting its four preferred stocks — STRF, STRC, STRK and STRD — accrue dividends every calendar day, with 99.3% of votes cast in favor. STRC moves to daily payouts in early November, while the other three follow in January 2027, a change the company says should reduce price swings around record dates. Read full story 🚨 zkLink Nova Bridge Drained of ~$780K via Forged Batch Root An attacker pulled roughly $779,000 in ETH and 11 ERC-20 tokens from zkLink Nova's Ethereum
